title: security: rbac v2 enforce kms region pinning + audit enhancements
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: tighten data residency guarantees by enforcing KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and improve audit visibility when pinning decisions are made. This PR introduces an opt-in enforcement flag for RBAC v2 policies, audit log enrichment for KMS region events, a migration script to surface existing policies with missing residency metadata, and a staged rollout plan behind a feature flag. Changes are backwards-compatible when the enforcement flag is off; operators can enable enforcement per-tenant after running the audit/migration report. Checklist: 1) add enforcement logic to RBAC v2 policy evaluation 2) emit structured audit events when KMS region is pinned or overridden 3) add migration tool and admin report 4) add unit/integration tests against local KMS emulator and residency matrix 5) document migration and runtime config 6) add canary rollout plan and feature flag gating. Context and rationale: customers operating under regional data residency requirements asked for both stronger server-side enforcement and better auditability so they can prove residency decisions to auditors. Prior PRs added region pin metadata at policy creation; this extends runtime evaluation and logging to make enforcement actionable. No user-facing API changes to the public Redwood API; admin tooling and RBAC internals are updated. Migration notes: a small migration script (scripts/migrate_kms_region_pinning.sh) enumerates RBAC policies and flags policies missing residency to admin report; recommended flow is to run migration in audit mode, review report, then flip enforcement for specific tenants. Rollout: gated by feature flag security.kms_region_pinning.enforce; default false; will be enabled for a small set of pilot tenants after internal compliance review. Testing: unit tests added for policy evaluator, integration tests against kms-emulator, e2e compliance smoke test added to nightly. CI: initial e2e failed due to timing in kms-emulator and was retried; final CI green. See release notes for operator steps.

release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 with enhanced audit logging and migration tooling. Feature is behind security.kms_region_pinning.enforce flag and non-breaking when off. Operators should run the migration report, remediate flagged policies, and then enable enforcement for pilots before broad rollout.
